rationale: With only 28 minutes to close and the stock sitting at 94.1% of its daily range near the session high, the risk/reward for a long is poor given proximity to resistance and the broad market down 4.33% with VIX surging 25.6%. A short against the intraday uptrend (price well above VWAP at $29.62, hugging the 9-EMA at $30.53) is equally unattractive given the tight consolidation and lack of directional momentum in the last five candles. The ATR is only ~$0.10, making meaningful profit targets difficult to achieve before forced liquidation at close.
